summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to declare its August 2026 monthly distributions across eight classes of common stock, with gross distribution of $0.1395 per share and net amounts ranging from $0.1206 to $0.1395 after stockholder servicing fees. The record date is August 31, 2026, and payment will occur on or about September 11, 2026, in cash or through the distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine operational disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction, strategic action, or material corporate event is involved.
